title: On spectral properties and fast initial convergence of the Kaczmarz method
summary: The Kaczmarz method is successfully used for solving discretizations of linear inverse problems, especially in computed tomography where it is known as ART. Practitioners often observe and appreciate its fast convergence in the first few iterations, leading to the same favorable semi-convergence that we observe for simultaneous iterative reconstruction methods.
